activation_disposition.reason: GraphST is a target-fitted spatial representation method with no upstream checkpoint, conflicting source-license declarations, no strict held-donor interface, and no eligible MASLD spatial task or external source.

architecture_contract.graph_default: three nearest spatial neighbors; dense all-pairs Euclidean distance for the 10X path and sklearn KNN for Stereo or Slide paths
architecture_contract.representation_objective: Graph convolutional reconstruction plus contrastive discrimination between observed and feature-permuted views.
architecture_contract.downstream_clustering: PCA of the target embedding followed by mclust, Leiden, or Louvain, with optional spatial majority refinement.
architecture_contract.deconvolution_extension: A separate scRNA autoencoder and a target-specific cell-to-spot mapping matrix are jointly optimized against the entire spatial target.
architecture_contract.warning: GraphST does not provide a frozen biological foundation checkpoint. Its published workflow learns the representation and clusters from the target sections.

implementation.publication_title: Spatially informed clustering, integration, and deconvolution of spatial transcriptomics with GraphST

checkpoint_contract.native_export: No immutable benchmark-ready save and strict-load contract is exposed by the selected workflow.
checkpoint_contract.required_future_identity: Every donor-fold and seed state must bind source, exact feature and graph order, preprocessing, target donors, scRNA reference if any, architecture, state dictionary, clusterer, refinement, and SHA-256.

source_terms_contract.conflict: The explicit repository license and package metadata disagree. Do not infer a permissive grant from setup metadata or a PyPI field.

preprocessing_contract.native_automatic_path: If highly_variable is absent, the code normalizes total counts, log-transforms, selects highly variable genes, and scales on the supplied target AnnData.
preprocessing_contract.feature_dimension: The learned input dimension is target-derived, commonly 3,000 HVGs. A frozen model cannot accept a new gene roster without an exact mapper.
preprocessing_contract.training_only_rule: For any donor-transfer task, HVGs, normalization references, scale, feature order, and any scRNA overlap roster must be fitted inside training donors.
preprocessing_contract.assay_limit: The registered implementation names 10X, Stereo, and Slide data. CosMx and other image-based panels require a separately validated assay path rather than reuse of the 10X flag.

graph_and_section_contract.construction: Build neighbor graphs independently inside authoritative participant, core, and section boundaries and combine them block-diagonally.
graph_and_section_contract.native_risk: Calling the native constructor on concatenated overlapping coordinates can create cross-section or cross-donor nearest neighbors.
graph_and_section_contract.memory_risk: The 10X constructor materializes a dense all-pairs distance matrix and dense adjacency, which is not admissible for large sections without a memory-safe equivalent and numeric parity.
graph_and_section_contract.required_lock: Freeze coordinate units, section boundaries, neighbor number, directed-to-symmetric conversion, self-loop and normalization policy, adjacency and graph_neigh arrays, and SHA-256.
graph_and_section_contract.refinement: Optional majority refinement is a target-spatial postprocessor and must be predeclared; its neighborhood size cannot be chosen from held labels.

held_donor_capability.official_lane: Transductive local fit on all supplied target spots. Embedding PCA, clusterer, resolution or cluster count, and optional refinement also use the target.
held_donor_capability.strict_frozen_lane: Unsupported by the official workflow. A future adapter would require a development-frozen feature roster, graph encoder state, cluster or prediction head, and section-local query graph with no target refit.
held_donor_capability.multi_sample_integration: Joint fitting or non-spatial alignment across target samples is transductive. Held donors cannot be pooled with each other or with training donors and called independent inference.
held_donor_capability.deconvolution: The mapping matrix is sized to and optimized on the full target spot and reference-cell set, so it is target-specific and not inductive.

selection_and_replication_contract.cluster_count: The official clustering API accepts a target number of clusters or searches resolution until that count is reached. The count and search rule must be frozen on development data, never read from held annotations.
selection_and_replication_contract.labels: Target labels cannot select epochs, graph K, PCA components, resolution, mclust model, refinement radius, deconvolution retain fraction, or seeds.
selection_and_replication_contract.replicates: Spots, nodes, graph edges, permuted views, clusters, and mapped cells are not biological replicates.

safe_loading_contract.native_state: No admitted pretrained object and no complete strict export path.
safe_loading_contract.required_path: If activated, serialize tensor-only state dictionaries or safetensors plus validated JSON and canonical arrays for feature order, graph policy, PCA, clusterer, and any mapping head. Reject pickle and unrestricted torch.load.
safe_loading_contract.strictness: Require exact keys, shapes, dtypes, finite values, feature order, section block structure, and deterministic fixed-fixture output.

runtime_contract.declared_stack: Python 3.8, PyTorch, Scanpy, AnnData, POT, scikit-learn, rpy2, and R mclust
runtime_contract.packaging_gap: setup.py lists only requests despite the substantially larger runtime, and no exact environment lock is registered.
runtime_contract.required_probe: After terms, data activation, and campaign approval only: L40S import, sparse graph parity, memory ceiling, forward, backward, state export, resume, deterministic permutation, donor block, node-order invariance, no-network, and cross-device tolerance through SLURM.

source_evidence: The Nature Communications article, official pinned GitHub source, official PyPI metadata, and Zenodo record were inspected online on 2026-08-22. The Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.6921985 archive is DeepST V1.0.0 and is not the selected GraphST implementation. No package, archive, model, or dataset was downloaded or run.
